## Introduction to GPU Programming

GPU programming involves a host processor (typically the CPU), and the device (the GPU).
To compute work on the GPU, programmers must provide data, a top-level function which accepts input arguments (known as the *kernel*), and execution parameters for the scheduler to use to distribute execution across threadgroups and threads.
